Master's thesisTH Brandenburg
2026

A polyglot database architecture for messy logistics data

Question
Waste logistics produces master data, sensor time series and free-form incident reports. Is it better to store each kind in the engine built for it, or keep everything in one relational database?
Approach
I built both. A Python ETL pipeline loads nine sources into PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB and MongoDB behind a single data access layer, and the same data also goes into a monolithic PostgreSQL 15 baseline. Both feed the same analytical views and dashboards, so they can be compared side by side.
  • PostgreSQL
  • TimescaleDB
  • MongoDB
  • Python
  • pandas
  • SQLAlchemy
  • PyMongo
